title.narrative: EU4Dialogue: Improving exchanges across the divide through education and culture

description.narrative: Overall, the Action intends to improve exchange (regional, intra-regional and/or with the EU) through education and culture for both women and men in the conflict regions. This is to be achieved by engaging the population in the conflict affected areas in education and culture and bringing them together with peers from the EU. The engagement will be realised in three sectors: youth and secondary education, tertiary education and academic sector as well as culture and arts
